text: Kathleen Winsor's Forever Amber was banned in Australia from 1945 to 1958, and the ban also applied to the expurgated English edition. The New Zealand Customs Department banned the entry of Forever Amber into the Dominion.
meta_description: Forever Amber by Kathleen Winsor: banned in Australia from 1945 to 1958, including the expurgated English edition, and barred entry to New Zealand by Customs.
changes: Author leads; Australia dated first, then New Zealand; no fact added.
